how_it_works: Public Node #s are issued sequentially in claim order (first claimant = Node 1) and published here. The first 500 claimed nodes are also named on the Dead Brands site. A claim starts with the wrapper in this repo (claim-node.sh): generate a key, prove possession, receive a route — then file the listing issue described in NODE-CLAIM.md. Fleet-internal node numbers (the fleet's own Node 1, etc.) are a separate internal sequence and are not part of this public registry.
